profile.reading: Per EdgeConneX own Chicago page, this facility, CHI01, publishes 24 MW of critical power and is described by EdgeConneX as fully occupied. EdgeConneX describes the Chicago campus as 25 miles from downtown Chicago and 6 miles from O Hare International Airport. The site is ENERGY STAR certified along with HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type 2, and ISO 27001 compliance.
profile.research_note: [session addition 2026-09-03] This row was previously exhausted with a company level source only and no location specific website on file. Fetched EdgeConneX own Chicago page this session, which distinguishes CHI01, 24 MW and fully occupied, CHI02, 7 MW N plus 1 planned with a 3 MW N plus 1 Phase 1, and CHI03, 22.4 MW, as 3 separate facilities on the same campus. This row is specifically CHI01, so only the CHI01 figures were applied here, and the Chicago page URL was added as this row own website and source. Also fetched EdgeConneX own company page fresh this session, finding the company was founded in 2009, was acquired by EQT Infrastructure in 2020, and operates over 90 data centers worldwide from 3 global headquarters. research_status upgraded from exhausted to complete.
